svg.title: Pi function-word usage at 30 digits
svg.desc: All used Toy words, comparing original and golfed programs. Source counts are linear; runtime counts use log10(1 + count).
svg.text: Exact counts are printed beside each bar; zero means unused.
Includes user words, built-ins, and control flow. Numeric literals and definition headers are excluded.
Runtime counts include the final newline emit. Skipped words and jump-target delimiters are excluded.
